title: Practice 9: за-: behind, and dropping in

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: ___ (зайти / заходить — to go, to come in, to call, to drop in) в окружный суд?
exercises.why: The prefix "за-" implies the following meaning: (a) Getting (disappearing) behind something — заходить, зайти за + Acc.: Солнце заходит за облака. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Пётр Боборыкин, «Китай-город».
exercises.context: The prefix "за-" implies the following meaning: (a) Getting (disappearing) behind something — заходить, зайти за + Acc.: Солнце заходит за облака.

exercises.q: Куда ты ___ (завезти / завозить — to take, to drop off) меня? — говорила Эльса.
exercises.why: **завезти́** — **завози́ть** — to take (to a place), to drop off (at a place); to supply, to deliver. **зале́зть** — **залеза́ть** — to climb up (finished action); (also figurative) to get into, to scramble. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Владимир Одоевский, «Саламандра».
exercises.context: завезти́** — **завози́ть — to take (to a place), to drop off (at a place); to supply, to deliver.

exercises.q: Луна ___ (зайти / заходить — to go, to come in, to call, to drop in) за облако.
exercises.why: **за-** — Movement behind an object; stopping off on the way — Старушка зашла за угол и исчезла. — The old woman walked behind the corner and disappeared. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Александр Пушкин, «Капитанская дочка».
exercises.context: за- — Movement behind an object; stopping off on the way — Старушка зашла за угол и исчезла. — The old woman walked behind the corner and disappeared.

exercises.q: Тишина покрыла квартиру, ___ (заползти / заползать — to crawl into) во все углы.
exercises.why: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress). — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Михаил Булгаков, «Собачье сердце».
exercises.context: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress).

exercises.q: ___ (заезжать / заехать — to drive into, to go into) вчера ко мне один художник.
exercises.why: Автомашина заезжает за дом. (b) Dropping in on somebody or stopping by at a certain place: заходить, зайти — в магазин, на почту, к учителю. (c) Dropping in or stopping by to fetch something or someone — заходить, зайти за + Instr.: Я зайду за вами. — I'll stop by to pick you up. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Удав и кролик».
exercises.context: Автомашина заезжает за дом.

exercises.q: Но ___ (забегать / забежать — to run ahead, to run before someone) вперед нечего.
exercises.why: **за-** (temporal) — Beginning of multidirectional movement, with multidirection verb of motion — Она забегала по комнате. — She started running around the room. — по + dat.. **зайти́** — **заходи́ть** — to go (to see), to come in (to see, etc.), to call, to drop in; to pick up, to fetch. **зае́хать** — **заезжа́ть** — to call in on the way; to drive into. **залете́ть** — **залета́ть** — to fly (in, into); to fly (as high as), to go up (as far as), to fly (as far as), to fly (behind, beyond). — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  From Фёдор Достоевский, «Бесы».
exercises.context: за- (temporal) — Beginning of multidirectional movement, with multidirection verb of motion — Она забегала по комнате. — She started running around the room. — по + dat..
